checks/independent/dfm-gribov-continuum-.role: Bounded rational3x3 weighted-trace verification application with owned weight aggregate, exact shape/resource admission, Railway value/difference operations and finite witness controls
checks/independent/dfm-gribov-continuum-.cost: Exactly3x3 matrices, each of9 entries an int/Fraction admitted to4096-bit numerator/denominator. All rows are shape-validated before entries are converted. A product uses27 bounded scalar products and27 bounded accumulations; trace uses3 bounded additions. A form value uses two products and one trace; a difference uses two form values and one bounded subtraction. Both difference operands are admitted before either evaluation. Work/storage are constant-size apart from bounded exact arithmetic. Default10 obligations split the former combined predicates; no enumeration or continuum construction.

groups.requirement: Admit only exact int/Fraction values and exactly3x3 list/tuple matrices; reject bool/float/foreign values, oversized rational inputs and malformed shapes before dependent arithmetic. Own all rows and compose multiplication through the shared bounded RationalMatrix, preserving legacy row-tuple output.
Compute the diagonal sum with a4096-bit check after every addition, including refusal of an oversized prefix even if a later negative term would cancel it. Validate public trace input as3x3 first.

TraceQuadraticForm owns an immutable rational3x3 weight and evaluates Tr(weight*H^2) for any admitted rational3x3 generator, without symmetry or positivity assumptions. Return Outcome for expected input/resource failures; unexpected programming errors and cancellation propagate.

Admit both generators before evaluating their weighted forms, then return the exact left-minus-right difference with a bounded output through Outcome. Resource refusal is distinct from a zero difference.

Preserve both generator squares, weight involution/diagonal determinant, two traces, three form values and their unequal difference as10 counted obligations. Require an explicit Cases recorder, emit a per-run JSON receipt and exit nonzero on failed verification. Claims remain finite rational matrix identities.

checks/independent/dfm-gribov-continuum-.consumer_boundary: Executable path and exact/mat/mul/trace/diag helper names and immutable row-tuple outputs remain. Previously unchecked3x3 assumptions become explicit shape/scalar/resource refusals. Arithmetic is composed into shared independent-checker RationalMatrix rather than duplicated. TraceQuadraticForm owns supplied weights and provides typed value/difference operations with no positivity claim. The prose-only CLI becomes a10-obligation JSON receipt with nonzero failure exit; no external Python consumers of prose output were found. Separate nonsymmetric SymPy controls challenge algebra beyond the fixed symmetric Lean witnesses. No continuum operator or scientific DAG status is promoted; historical receipts retain their source hashes.
